segments.name: medical device
segments.description: Sells the NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System, an office-based TMS system, to healthcare providers.
segments.evidence: We designed the NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System as a non-invasive therapeutic alternative to treat patients who suffer from MDD and to address many of the key limitations of existing treatment options.

segments.name: clinic services
segments.description: Operates Greenbrook Treatment Centers across the U.S. offering NeuroStar Advanced Therapy and SPRAVATO for mental health treatment.
segments.evidence: The Company reports the results of our operations as two segments in our consolidated financial statements: (i) medical device and (ii) clinic services.

revenueModel.text: Provider customers pay for NeuroStar systems, service contracts and recurring treatment sessions; clinic revenue comes from Treatment Centers.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate NeuroStar revenues from clinic revenue, capital sales of our systems, sales of our recurring treatment sessions, service and repair and extended warranty contracts.

changes.text: In 2025 the company moved from one reportable segment to two reportable segments: medical device and clinic services.
changes.evidence: Effective October 1, 2025, the Company realigned its reportable segments to reflect the way the Company's CODM assesses performance and allocates resources.
